# Schedule

The cron entries that osapi deploys. `osapi behavior get --name schedule` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same. [Its chain](../../chains/schedule.md)
shows each call that its examples make.

## Method list

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | list                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Description | List the cron entries that osapi deployed                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Detail      | Lists each file in /etc/cron.d and in /etc/cron.hourly, daily, weekly and monthly that osapi deployed, with its object, its cron expression or interval, and its user. A cron file that osapi did not deploy is not listed. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/schedule                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Permission  | schedule:read                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Command     | [osapi client node schedule list](../../../usage/cli/client/node/schedule/list.md)                                                                                                                                          |
| Input type  | ListInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Output type | \[]Entry                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

### Output (6)

| FIELD    | TYPE   | DESCRIPTION                                                |
| -------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| name     | string | The entry                                                  |
| object   | string | The object it was deployed from                            |
| schedule | string | Its cron expression, for an entry in /etc/cron.d           |
| interval | string | Its interval, for a script in /etc/cron.daily and the like |
| user     | string | The user it runs as                                        |
| source   | string | Where its file is: cron.d, or the interval                 |

### Examples (3)

| EXAMPLE                            | INPUT  | OUTPUT                                                                                 |
| ---------------------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| An entry that osapi deployed       | (none) | \[name=osapitest, object=osapitest.cron, schedule=0 2 * * *, source=cron.d, user=root] |
| A daily script that osapi deployed | (none) | \[interval=daily, name=osapitest, object=osapitest.sh, source=daily]                   |
| A host where osapi deployed none   | (none) |                                                                                        |

## Method create

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | create                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Description | Deploy a cron entry                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Detail      | Gets the object from the object store and writes it as /etc/cron.d/backup for backup, mode 0644, for a cron expression, or as /etc/cron.daily/backup, mode 0755, for a daily interval. An object of content type template, or content_type template, is rendered with the agent's facts and the vars. A file that has the content does not change. An entry of the name in a different directory does not change: move it with delete and create. A file at the path that osapi did not deploy is refused. An entry runs as its user, root included, so only admin can deploy one. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/schedule                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Permission  | schedule:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Command     | [osapi client node schedule create](../../../usage/cli/client/node/schedule/create.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Input type  | CreateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

### Input (7)

| FIELD        | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                              | DESCRIPTION                                                                                                          |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name         | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$, max length 64 | The entry, and its file name, such as backup                                                                         |
| object       | string | yes      | min length 1, max length 255             | The object that holds the entry, from osapi client file upload                                                       |
| schedule     | string | no       |                                          | A cron expression, such as */5 * * * *; give it or interval                                                          |
| interval     | string | no       | one of hourly daily weekly monthly       | The interval of a script in /etc/cron.daily and the like; give it or schedule                                        |
| user         | string | no       | pattern ^\[a-z_]\[a-z0-9_-]*\$?$         | The user the entry runs as                                                                                           |
| content_type | string | no       | one of raw template                      | The content type: raw, or template to render the object with the agent's facts and vars; the object's own when empty |
| vars         | object | no       |                                          | The vars of a template, as key=value                                                                                 |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| name    | string  | The entry                |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (5)

| EXAMPLE                                       | INPUT                                                                                                    | OUTPUT                        |
| --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| An entry with a cron expression               | name=osapitest, object=osapitest.cron, schedule=0 2 * * *, user=root                                     | name=osapitest, changed=true  |
| A script that runs daily                      | name=osapitest, object=osapitest.sh, interval=daily                                                      | name=osapitest, changed=true  |
| A template, rendered with its vars            | name=osapitest, object=osapitest.tmpl, schedule=0 2 * * *, content_type=template, vars=map\[target:/srv] | name=osapitest, changed=true  |
| An entry that has the content                 | name=osapitest, object=osapitest.cron, schedule=0 2 * * *, user=root                                     | name=osapitest, changed=false |
| An entry of the name in a different directory | name=osapitest, object=osapitest.sh, interval=daily                                                      | name=osapitest, changed=false |

## Method update

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | update                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Description | Deploy a cron entry that osapi deployed again                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Detail      | Writes a new object, or the entry's own, at the entry's path, with the fields that the request gives and the entry's own for the rest. A file that has the content does not change. An entry that osapi did not deploy is not found. The entry stays in its directory: an interval does not change with update. |
| HTTP        | PUT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/schedule/&#123;name&#125;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Permission  | schedule:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Command     | [osapi client node schedule update](../../../usage/cli/client/node/schedule/update.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Input type  | UpdateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

### Input (6)

| FIELD        | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                              | DESCRIPTION                                                    |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name         | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$, max length 64 | The entry, such as backup                                      |
| object       | string | no       | min length 1, max length 255             | The object to deploy; the entry's own when empty               |
| schedule     | string | no       |                                          | A new cron expression; the entry's own when empty              |
| user         | string | no       | pattern ^\[a-z_]\[a-z0-9_-]*\$?$         | The user the entry runs as; the entry's own when empty         |
| content_type | string | no       | one of raw template                      | The content type, raw or template; the object's own when empty |
| vars         | object | no       |                                          | The vars of a template, as key=value                           |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| name    | string  | The entry                |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (3)

| EXAMPLE                                | INPUT                                                                      | OUTPUT                       |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| A new object                           | name=osapitest, object=osapitest-v2.cron                                   | name=osapitest, changed=true |
| A new object, cron expression and user | name=osapitest, object=osapitest-v2.cron, schedule=30 2 * * *, user=nobody | name=osapitest, changed=true |
| A daily script with a new object       | name=osapitest, object=osapitest-v2.sh                                     | name=osapitest, changed=true |
